questions.prompt: Who lived on either side of Anne-Marie? G
questions.passage:
The moon poured its silvery light over the front lawn. Anne-Marie kneeled on her bed and stared out at it. A cat passed across from Mrs Thompson's hedge next door and quickly disappeared into the Mara's place on the other side. She knew that the cat didn't belong to anyone in the three houses. A few times she had seen it sitting inside the window of a house two streets away. She knew that was where it lived.

Unable to sleep, she stayed where she was. Finally, when clouds covered the moon, she gave up watching and slipped into her bed.

questions.prompt: Why did the magician choose the woman? JR
questions.passage:
THE MAGICIAN

The magician was very good. The audience loved him. At the end of each act, they clapped and laughed and yelled for more. Then he called out, "For my last trick, I'll need some help from someone who is wearing glasses." He looked at the eager faces before him. He pointed at a woman. "Do you want to be my helper?" Smiling, she went up to him, and put her glasses into the little velvet bag he was holding out. He held it up. Then, to everyone's horror, he threw it to the ground and jumped on it. The woman stared, speechless. Then, realising that this was just a magician's trick, relaxed.

"Would you pick the bag up please?"

She did so.

"Now open it and tip your glasses onto the table."

She did that too. Out of the bag fell the broken pieces of a pair of glasses. She smiled at the magician, waiting to be reassured that her glasses were somewhere safe, in one piece.

But he was looking at the broken pieces with dismay. He stroked his chin and coughed gently

"I'm sorry. It's gone wrong. I don't know how. I've done this glasses trick a hundred times."

The audience went very quiet. The woman stared at him. She didn't know what to say. Her smile was gone.

"I'll replace them, of course."

There was still silence. Everyone was wondering what the woman would do.

"I can lend you this pair while your new ones are being made." He reached into his pocket and pulled out a pair of glasses. He handed them to her. She looked at them and then burst out laughing. She could see that they were hers. The magician bowed to the audience, who applauded long and loudly.
